description: Return one recipe change job by jobId (the jobId propose_recipe_change returned): { id, element, status, pr_url, pr_number, branch, error, batch_id, created_at, started_at, finished_at }. status moves queued → running → pr_opened, or ends rejected or failed with the reason in error; a job stuck past its deadline reads as failed. Optional projectId. Read-only.

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to the server-configured project when omitted (`project_id` is accepted too.)

name: get_recipe_change
title: Recipe change status
